subject: Improve "SENTINEL FAILOVER" by using the "FAILOVER" command (#1292)
reason: The change is confined to Sentinel mode: new COORDINATED option and failover state machine in src/sentinel.c, plus SENTINEL FAILOVER command metadata. The fuzzer can only deploy standalone/cluster data nodes and private servers started as ordinary valkey-server processes; sentinel mode requires the --sentinel argv flag at startup, which no deployment shape, server_config, or component can set. The SENTINEL command is CMD_ONLY_SENTINEL and is not registered outside sentinel mode, so on any reachable server both builds reply 'unknown command' identically, including the changed arity/metadata.
